body:
RossG12345 wrote:
> 
> Peter discusses TK's view that revolutionaries should
> have as many children as they can.
> 
> "Revolutionaries should have as many children as they can."


Revolutionaries shouldn't have kids at all. As soon as you have children
you are concerned for their safety/survival. You won't take risks or do
things that might get you in the slammer because "who'd take care of my
kids?"
Take it from one who knows.

When my kids were little, I didn't even want to THINK about revolution
or anything that might rock the boat.

However, when learning of the potential threats to their future (nuclear
winter, eco-catastrophe) I will admit that I eventually started to get
concerned & angry.

But I was in a lesser position to do anything about it, because first I
had to take care of the kids & then I had to *earn a good living* to
support them.
